# DoubleLayer Photography

DoubleLayer Photography is the top wedding photography company in Kochi offering creative, affordable packages for candid wedding photography, pre-wedding shoots, cinematic films, Christian, Hindu, and Muslim weddings across Kerala.

## Primary Keywords & Positioning
- **Primary Focus**: Best Wedding Photography in Kochi
- **Creative Services**: Creative Photographer in Kochi
- **Packages & Pricing**: Affordable Packages Wedding Photography Company in Kochi
- **Pre-Wedding Shoots**: Best Prewedding Shoot Company in Kochi
- **Specializations**: Candid Wedding Photographer Kochi, Christian Wedding Photographer Kerala, Luxury Wedding Photographer Kochi, Destination Wedding Photographer Kerala, Cinematic Wedding Photography Kochi.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Candid Wedding Photography**: Fine-art compositions, candid portraits, emotional moment curation.
- **Pre Wedding Shoot & Couple Photoshoot**: Creative pre-wedding concept sessions in Kochi, Kumarakom, Munnar, and Alleppey backwaters.
- **Cinematic Wedding Films & Highlights**: High-definition teasers, 4K wedding videography, and drone cinematography.
- **Christian, Hindu & Muslim Wedding Photography**: Comprehensive coverage of sacred rituals, church liturgies, mandap ceremonies, and reception nights.
- **Milestone Photography**: Fine-art baby shoots, christening / baptism ceremony films, engagement sessions, and family portraits.

## Venue Experience in Kochi & Kerala
Expert wedding photography coverage at top luxury venues and resorts:
- Le Méridien Kochi
- Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty
- Ramada Resort by Wyndham Kochi
- Gokulam Convention Centre Kochi
- Bolgatty Palace & Island Resort
- Lulu International Convention Centre

## Locations Served
Kochi, Ernakulam, Kottayam, Alappuzha, Thrissur, Munnar, Kumarakom, Alleppey, Trivandrum, Calicut, as well as destination wedding commissions in the UK, UAE (Dubai), and Australia.
